content: sops-nix autodocs (HIGH): sops.age.keyFile must be a string path OUTSIDE the Nix store (type str|null; 'path must not reside in the Nix store'); a Nix path literal copies the private key into the world-readable store. age.generateKey creates the key on first deployment. README: adding a host requires sops updatekeys on every secrets file the host needs ('sops updatekeys secrets/example.yaml' with sops installed). key_groups YAML pitfall: subsequent key types under key_groups must be dash-prefixed lists (age:/pgp: with '-' bullets); a non-list scalar makes sops use Shamir secret-sharing semantics requiring multiple keys to decrypt. README also notes defaultSopsFile = ./secrets.yaml adds the (encrypted) file to the nix store - acceptable (ciphertext) but prefer string full path to avoid; validateSopsFiles option exists to validate sops files during evaluation.
